jobs.title: Product Manager (Supply Chain)
jobs.description:
OVERVIEW

First Resonance is seeking a Product Manager – Supply Chain to lead the vision, strategy, and execution of our supply chain and inventory management product capabilities. Modern hardware manufacturers—building rockets, autonomous vehicles, robotics, and clean energy tech—face massive supply chain bottlenecks, traceability challenges, and supplier complexity. You will translate deep supply chain and manufacturing insights into intuitive, high-impact software solutions.

At First Resonance, our product managers operate close to the metal. While deep domain fluency in manufacturing supply chains is our top priority for this role, our PMs are technically hands-on—comfortable analyzing data, building functional prototypes, navigating APIs, and occasionally pushing code. You will join a high-impact product team working directly with engineers, factory planners, procurement teams, and hardware leaders to build the future of industrial software.




RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES

As a Product Manager focusing on Supply Chain, you will own the end-to-end product lifecycle for our supply chain, procurement, inventory, and traceability modules.

 - Drive Supply Chain Product Strategy: Define and champion the roadmap for supply chain capabilities (e.g., purchase order tracking, vendor management, inventory allocation, lot/serial traceability, and BOM/MRP synchronization) aligned with high-tech hardware manufacturing needs.

 - Solve Intricate Supply Chain Bottlenecks: Partner directly with supply chain directors, procurement leads, inventory managers, and manufacturing engineers to deeply understand operational pains and design elegant software solutions.

 - Bridge Strategy & Technical Delivery: Translate complex hardware supply chain logic into clear technical specs, wireframes, and functional prototypes. Work closely with engineering to build, test, and ship high-quality features fast.

 - Hands-on Execution: Engage in modern, technical product development workflows, including building functional prototypes, running data queries, and contributing directly to the product codebase when needed.

 - Champion User-Centric Design: Conduct field research, iterative prototyping, and user acceptance testing with factory and supply chain teams to simplify complex, legacy workflows.

 - Data-Driven Decision Making: Analyze user behavior, inventory flow metrics, and customer feedback to measure feature impact, validate new product hypotheses, and optimize customer outcomes.

 - Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate across Engineering, Product Design, Customer Success, and Sales to ensure our supply chain offerings deliver measurable ROI and seamless onboarding for customers.


MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

 - 3+ years of experience in Product Management, Supply Chain Operations, Industrial Engineering, or related technical fields, with exposure to software development environments.

 - Deep Domain Understanding: Strong knowledge of manufacturing supply chain operations (e.g., procurement workflows, inventory/WMS logic, bill of materials, component traceability, vendor management).

 - Technical Aptitude: Comfortable with modern software technical concepts, APIs, database/data structure principles, and eager to work in a environment where PMs push code, run scripts, or build functional prototypes.

 - Product Lifecycle Ownership: Proven track record of taking product features from initial customer research and requirements gathering through delivery, launch, and post-release iteration.

 - Systems Thinking: Ability to map out complex multi-party workflows (suppliers, factory floor, inventory managers, engineering) down to edge cases and systemic dependencies.

 - Customer-Centric Communication: Excellent ability to speak fluently with both factory-floor specialists/supply chain directors and software engineers.

 - Adaptability: Thrives in an agile startup environment with a high degree of autonomy and ownership.


DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Hands-on experience with hardware/manufacturing supply chain software, such as ERPs (e.g., NetSuite, SAP), MES, PLM, or specialized inventory/procurement systems.

 - Practical coding experience (e.g., Python, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL) or a background in Software/Industrial Engineering.

 - Experience utilizing AI-assisted tools for rapid prototyping, specification drafting, and data analysis.

 - Experience working directly with advanced hardware manufacturing sectors (e.g., aerospace, defense, automotive, energy, or robotics).


BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Health Insurance: medical, vision, dental, & life insurance.

 - Paid Parental Leave.

 - Employee Stock Option Plan.

 - Team outings, group lunches, open office, happy hours.

 - Paid holidays, sick days.

 - Flexible Friday and PTO.

 - 401(k).



First Resonance is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce. First Resonance participates in E-Verify.

Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location.




ABOUT FIRST RESONANCE

First Resonance accelerates the speed and reliability of hardware development for companies manufacturing the next generation of hardware products. This includes space exploration, electric airplanes, autonomous vehicles, nuclear reactors, robotics, and more. We are a group of software, hardware, and manufacturing engineers bringing the best of modern UX and data science to an industry that has been overly rigid in its innovation. We are removing the barriers preventing radical advancement by providing tools to manufacturing engineers and operators to move information more freely, collaborate with their teams more easily, and use the power of data to predict problems and provide insights that result in better hardware quality and delivery.

jobs.title: Associate Product Manager
jobs.description:
ASSOCIATE PRODUCT MANAGER 




OVERVIEW

First Resonance is seeking an Associate Product Manager to help build innovative software solutions. This role is designed for a professional who is ready to grow their career in product management and is passionate about customer experience and product adoption.

As an Associate PM, your primary focus will be interacting directly with new customers to ensure seamless product adoption. You will translate customer needs into functional requirements, and work daily with engineers to ship high-quality features. You will join a high-impact team where you will be mentored by senior leaders while taking direct ownership of specific product modules that shape the first-time user experience.




RESPONSIBILITIES & DUTIES

As an Associate Product Manager, your primary goal is to contribute to the design and delivery of product experiences that help new customers realize the value of our platform quickly. You will manage the lifecycle of specific features, from initial discovery through to launch and optimization.

 - Customer Advocacy: Interact directly with new customers to ensure early success. Support user research sessions and customer interviews, translating user feedback into product improvements to ensure features meet customer needs.

 - Feature Execution & Delivery: Take ownership of defined product areas related to user onboarding, ensuring the backlog is prioritized and that the engineering team has clear, actionable user stories and requirements.

 - Problem Solving: Work with senior product leaders to break down customer adoption barriers into manageable product tasks and functional solutions.

 - Cross-functional Collaboration: Act as the primary point of contact for Engineering and Design on your assigned features. Collaborate directly with Customer Success and Sales to ensure a smooth transition for new customers and that new releases are easily understood.

 - Data-Informed Contributions: Use data and user feedback to track the success of launched features and suggest iterative improvements based on actual usage patterns.

 - Product Rituals: Participate in and help facilitate agile ceremonies, including daily stand-ups, sprint planning, and retrospectives.




MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS & SKILLS

 - 2 - 4 years of experience in a manufacturing engineering type position (touching the manufacturing floor).

 - Customer-Centric Mindset: Deep empathy for users and a strong desire to interact directly with new customers to understand their goals, challenges, and workflows during the onboarding phase.

 - Strong Execution Skills: Proven ability to manage tasks effectively, meet deadlines, and communicate progress clearly to stakeholders.

 - Analytical Mindset: Ability to use data to understand problems and a willingness to learn advanced product analytics tools to monitor user activation.

 - Familiarity with Modern Tools: Proficiency in (or a strong desire to learn) leveraging AI tools for drafting specifications, organizing feedback, and streamlining the product development process.

 - Communication: Clear verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical team members and confidently lead customer-facing meetings.

 - Growth Mindset: A proactive approach to learning the discipline of Product Management and building great software.




DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Foundational experience working within an Agile/Scrum framework.

 - Experience in a customer-facing role

 - Basic understanding of how web applications work (e.g., an interest in how APIs, JSON, or data flow works between systems).

 - Passion for technology and a desire to improve the lives of the people using complex software tools.

 - Strongly Desired: Experience working on the manufacturing floor. Experience as a manufacturing engineer is highly desired.




BENEFITS & PERKS

 - Health Insurance; medical, vision, dental, & life insurance.

 - Paid Parental Leave.

 - Employee Stock Option Plan.

 - Team outings, group lunches, open office, happy hours.

 - Paid holidays, sick days.

 - Flexible Friday and PTO.

 - 401K.

First Resonance is an equal opportunity employer dedicated to building an inclusive and diverse workforce.

First Resonance participates in E-Verify. As part of our onboarding process, a new hire's Form I-9 information will be shared with the federal government to confirm they are authorized to work in the U.S.

Pay is based on factors such as (but not limited to) scope and responsibilities of the position, candidate's work experience and skillset, and location.
